title: Frozen yogurt cone, chocolate, waffle cone

content.title: About
content.content: A frozen yogurt cone is a yogurt‑based ice cream coated with a thin layer of chocolate and served in a crisp waffle cone. It combines the refreshing tang of yogurt, the sweetness of chocolate, and the crunchy texture of the wafer.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Yogurt ice cream contains live probiotic cultures that may support gut health.
The chocolate coating is often made from dark chocolate with a high cocoa percentage for a richer flavor.
Waffle cones are traditionally baked from a butter‑enriched batter, giving them a golden, crisp finish.
The yogurt‑chocolate combination is popular in warm climates where lighter desserts are preferred.
Some waffle cone recipes include a touch of sugar and vanilla to enhance aroma.

items.title: Rich in probiotics
items.content: The yogurt base provides live bacterial cultures that can aid digestive health.

items.title: Lower fat than traditional ice cream
items.content: Yogurt‑based frozen desserts usually contain less butterfat, making them less calorie‑dense.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: Yogurt is a good source of calcium, essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Antioxidants in chocolate
items.content: Dark chocolate supplies flavonoids that may support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Waffle cone provides quick carbs
items.content: The crisp cone delivers fast‑acting energy, convenient for active individuals.

items.title: Dairy allergy or lactose intolerance
items.content: Yogurt contains lactose, so people with dairy allergies or intolerance should be cautious.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Both the chocolate coating and the yogurt ice cream can contain significant sugar, which may be unsuitable for diabetics or those watching weight.

items.title: Nut and soy allergens
items.content: Chocolate often contains nuts or soy lecithin, which can trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Caloric waffle cone
items.content: The cone adds extra calories and carbohydrates, so portion control is recommended.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the cone straight from the freezer to keep the wafer crisp. Top with fresh berries, nuts, or a sprinkle of cinnamon for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. Over time the chocolate coating may darken, but the taste remains unchanged. Do not leave at room temperature for more than 30 minutes, as the waffle cone will soften.
